diagram_previews.alt: Cross-section of the cone: isosceles triangle VAB with base AB, apex V, and its blue inscribed circle with centre O on the dashed axis VM. Red radii r go from O to the midpoint M of AB and to the touching point F on VA, each with a right-angle mark. MB is labelled 6, VB is labelled 2 root 34, and a dimension line on the left marks the height 10.
